dialogue.content: こんばんわ
dialogue.English: Good evening.

dialogue.content: こんばんわ。
dialogue.English: Good evening.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Thank you for having me.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: I look forward to our session as well.

dialogue.content: 今日はどのようなお話でしょうか？
dialogue.English: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 先日婚約をしたのですが、迷っていて。。。
dialogue.English: I recently got engaged, but I'm having second thoughts...

dialogue.content: はい、婚約されたんですね、、
dialogue.English: I see, so you got engaged...

dialogue.content: でも迷ってらっしゃるんですね
dialogue.English: But you're having second thoughts.

dialogue.content: それは、お悩みですね
dialogue.English: That must be troubling for you.

dialogue.content: はい。うちの両親にも、彼の両親にも会いに行ってしまったし、式場も予約してしまったので、今更なのですが。。。
dialogue.English: Yes. We've already met both of our parents, and we've even booked a wedding venue, so I know it's late to be saying this, but...

dialogue.content: はい、そのような状況なのですね
dialogue.English: I see, so that's the situation.

dialogue.content: もう少しお聞きさせてください
dialogue.English: Could you tell me a little more?

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どのようなところで迷ってらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: In what ways are you feeling uncertain?

dialogue.content: 私は東京で彼が静岡に住んでいて、遠距離恋愛だったのですが、結婚したら静岡で同居しなくてはならなくて。。。
dialogue.English: I live in Tokyo and he lives in Shizuoka, so we've been in a long-distance relationship. But once we get married, I'll have to live with him in Shizuoka...

dialogue.content: はい、そうなんですね。静岡に引っ越されるんですね
dialogue.English: I see. So you would be moving to Shizuoka.

dialogue.content: 静岡、同居、どんなところが気になりますか？
dialogue.English: What concerns you about Shizuoka and living there together?

dialogue.content: はい。プロポーズされた時は、お互い仕事もしているし、中間地点に住もうとはなしていたのですが…
dialogue.English: Yes. When he proposed, we talked about living somewhere in the middle since we both have careers...

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 彼の家に挨拶に行った時に同居の話を持ちかけられて。。。
dialogue.English: But when I went to his parents' house to greet them, the topic of moving in with them came up...

dialogue.content: はい、そうなんですね、ご両親と同居の話が・・・
dialogue.English: I see, so the topic of living with his parents came up...

dialogue.content: 私の方も仕事が軌道に乗って楽しくなって来ていたのですが、彼のご両親に仕事は辞めろと言われてしまって。。。
dialogue.English: My career was just starting to take off and I was really enjoying it, but his parents told me to quit my job...

dialogue.content: そうなんです。なんだか、騙された気分で。。。
dialogue.English: Yes. I kind of feel like I was misled...

dialogue.content: はい、そうなんですね、、それは話が違うって感じなんですね
dialogue.English: I see... So it feels like this isn't what you agreed to.

dialogue.content: 困惑しちゃいますよね
dialogue.English: That must be very confusing.

dialogue.content: はい。彼も私が仕事大好きなのを知っていて応援してくれていたのですが、両親の言う事には逆らえないって言い出して。。。
dialogue.English: Yes. He knew how much I love my job and was always supportive, but now he's saying he can't go against his parents...

dialogue.content: そうですか、、彼も同意見なんですね寂しい感じですよね
dialogue.English: I see... so he agrees with them now. That must feel lonely.

dialogue.content: はい。今まで7年間応援しててくれたのはなんだったんだろう。。。ってなっちゃいました。
dialogue.English: Yes. It made me wonder what the last seven years of his support were all for...

dialogue.content: 7年ですか、
dialogue.English: Seven years...

dialogue.content: それはそうですよね、戸惑っちゃいますよね
dialogue.English: I can understand that. It's natural to feel bewildered.

dialogue.content: はい、20代前半からでお互いアラサーになりかけてるので、そろそろ結婚。。。ってなったのはいいんですけど。。。
dialogue.English: Yes, we've been together since our early twenties and we're both approaching our thirties, so it was good that we started talking about marriage... but...

dialogue.content: やっぱり女性は家庭に入らなきゃいけないものなのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Do women really have to become housewives?

dialogue.content: そうですか、7年間愛を育まれてこられたんですね
dialogue.English: I see, so you've nurtured your love for seven years.

dialogue.content: なるほど、女性が家庭にってそう思っちゃいますよね
dialogue.English: I understand why you'd start to think that women are expected to stay at home.

dialogue.content: そんな大層なものではないですが笑喧嘩をしながらも支え合って来れたと思っていました。
dialogue.English: It wasn't anything that grand, haha, but I thought we had supported each other through our arguments.

dialogue.content: なぜご両親が仕事辞めてって言われたか気になりますね
dialogue.English: I wonder why his parents told you to quit your job.

dialogue.content: ごめなさい
dialogue.English: I'm sorry.

dialogue.content: 話がぜんごしちゃいました
dialogue.English: I got a bit ahead of myself.

dialogue.content: こちらこそすみません
dialogue.English: No, I'm sorry as well.

dialogue.content: 7年間支え合ってこられて、
dialogue.English: You've supported each other for seven years, and...

dialogue.content: そうですね、彼のお母様が専業主婦だったのもあるかと思うのですが…
dialogue.English: That's right. I think part of it might be that his mother was a full-time homemaker...

dialogue.content: あ、すみません💦
dialogue.English: Oh, sorry.

dialogue.content: はい、どうぞ！
dialogue.English: No, please go ahead!

dialogue.content: 専業主婦だったんですね
dialogue.English: So she was a full-time homemaker.

dialogue.content: はい。私が東京で割と派手な仕事をしていて、見た目も派手に見えてしまったのかな。。。『東京の女』って呼ばれてるのも聞いてしまって。。。嫌われてるのかもしれません。
dialogue.English: Yes. I have a rather glamorous job in Tokyo, and I guess my appearance might seem flashy too... I also overheard them calling me 'the Tokyo woman'... Maybe they don't like me.

dialogue.content: そんな事あったんですね、、
dialogue.English: That really happened...

dialogue.content: はい。ちょっと笑えるくらい衝撃でした。
dialogue.English: Yes. It was so shocking it was almost laughable.

dialogue.content: 気になりますよね
dialogue.English: That would be concerning.

dialogue.content: そうですね。自分の事そんな呼び方してる人と一生一緒に住むのとか怖すぎて。。。
dialogue.English: It is. The thought of living my whole life with people who call me that is just too scary...

dialogue.content: なるほど、不安になりますよね
dialogue.English: I see. It's understandable that you'd feel anxious.

dialogue.content: はい。彼もご両親には逆らえない様なので。。。
dialogue.English: Yes. And it seems my fiancé can't stand up to his parents...

dialogue.content: なるほど、、ご両親はどんな感じの方なのですか？
dialogue.English: I see... What are his parents like?

dialogue.content: 普通に雑談をしている時は、冗談を言ったり面白い方々なのですが。。。
dialogue.English: When we're just making small talk, they're funny people who joke around, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 結婚後の生活については、彼らの言うことに従わせる圧みたいなのが凄く強かったです。
dialogue.English: When it comes to life after marriage, there was this intense pressure to make me obey them.

dialogue.content: なるほど、少し不安な気持ちになっちゃいますよね
dialogue.English: I see. That would certainly make you feel a bit anxious.

dialogue.content: 圧とは、どんな感じでしたか？
dialogue.English: What kind of pressure was it?

dialogue.content: 嫁は主人を支えるために居るんだから、彼のためになんだってやってあげる覚悟がないと、とか。
dialogue.English: Things like, 'A wife exists to support her husband, so you need to be prepared to do anything for him.'

dialogue.content: なるほど、
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 他にもございますか？
dialogue.English: Was there anything else?

dialogue.content: 彼らの家に入るのだから、自分の意思よりも、家を尊重すべきであるとか。
dialogue.English: And, 'Since you're marrying into our family, you should respect the family's ways more than your own will.'

dialogue.content: はい・・・
dialogue.English: Mm-hm...

dialogue.content: そういうのも大事だとは思うのですが、自分が想像していた結婚生活とはかけ離れすぎていて。。。
dialogue.English: I think those things are important to some extent, but it's just so far from the married life I had imagined...

dialogue.content: そうですよね、少し現代っぽくないように感じちゃいますね・・・
dialogue.English: I understand. It feels a little old-fashioned, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: 不安になっちゃいますね
dialogue.English: It's natural to feel anxious.

dialogue.content: なぜ、ご両親はこのような事を言われるんですかね？
dialogue.English: I wonder why his parents say things like that.

dialogue.content: なんでなんでしょうか。。。
dialogue.English: I wonder why...

dialogue.content: 土地柄とかもあるんですかね？
dialogue.English: Could it be a regional thing?

dialogue.content: 彼のお姉さんも専業主婦をされているので。。。
dialogue.English: His older sister is also a full-time homemaker...

dialogue.content: なるほど、静岡の土地柄でしょうか
dialogue.English: I see—perhaps it's the local culture in Shizuoka.

dialogue.content: 専業主婦が、普通って感じなんですかね
dialogue.English: Perhaps being a full-time homemaker is considered the norm there.

dialogue.content: はい。嫁が外に働きに出てるのは恥ずかい事なのかもしれないですね。ただ、当初の予定では夫婦共働きの予定だったので、面食らってしまいまして。。。
dialogue.English: Yes. Maybe it's considered shameful for a wife to work outside the home. It's just that our original plan was for us both to work, so I was completely taken aback...

dialogue.content: そうですよね、悩んじゃいますよね
dialogue.English: I understand—that's a lot to grapple with.

dialogue.content: 彼は何ておしゃってますか？
dialogue.English: What does your fiancé say?

dialogue.content: 両親がそう言うなら逆らえないって。。。
dialogue.English: He says that if his parents say so, he can't go against them...

dialogue.content: だから、始めからご両親とグルで嵌めようとしたんじゃないかなんて思ってしまって。。。
dialogue.English: That's why I've started to think that maybe he was in on it with his parents from the beginning to trick me...

dialogue.content: なるほど、、彼も専業主婦になってくれって感じなんですね
dialogue.English: I see... so it seems he also wants you to become a full-time homemaker.

dialogue.content: 非常に重要な事だと思いますが、
dialogue.English: I think this is a very important issue,

dialogue.content: はい。。。
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: 私は本当に好きな仕事をしていて、下積みも長かったので、やっと形になりそうな時にそれを辞めろと言われたのがショックでしたね。
dialogue.English: I truly love my work, and I spent a long time paying my dues, so being told to quit just when it was finally taking shape was a shock.

dialogue.content: 彼氏さんは相談者さまのご意見を
dialogue.English: Does your fiancé

dialogue.content: 聞き入れる感じではないですか？
dialogue.English: not seem receptive to your opinion?

dialogue.content: そうですね。
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: そうですか、、
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 旦那を支えるためには、そんな仕事もう辞めちゃいなよ、って言われました。
dialogue.English: He told me, 'If you're going to support your husband, just quit that kind of job.'

dialogue.content: 相談者様が、ここまで悩まれていることは
dialogue.English: Does your fiancé know

dialogue.content: 彼氏さんはご存知ですか？
dialogue.English: how much this is troubling you?

dialogue.content: はい、泣いて怒ったので。。。(汗)
dialogue.English: Yes, because I cried and got angry... (laughs nervously)

dialogue.content: そうですか、そこまで訴えても彼氏さんは考えてくれない感じですか？
dialogue.English: I see. And even after you expressed yourself so strongly, he still won't reconsider?

dialogue.content: はい。。。そんなに言うなら、自分で両親説得すれば？　俺は何もしないけど。って言われました。。。
dialogue.English: Yes... He said, 'If you're going to make that big a deal of it, why don't you convince my parents yourself? I'm not going to do anything.'

dialogue.content: えーーー、、
dialogue.English: Wow...

dialogue.content: 自分達の結婚なのに、意思は無いのかー💢
dialogue.English: It's our marriage, doesn't he have a mind of his own?!

dialogue.content: ってなりました笑
dialogue.English: That's what I felt, haha.

dialogue.content: その対応、、気になりますね・・・
dialogue.English: That response... is concerning...

dialogue.content: はい、初めからこれじゃあ先が思いやられますよね。。。
dialogue.English: Yes, if it's like this from the start, it makes me worry about the future...

dialogue.content: 相談者様が、婚約破棄まで悩まれてることは彼氏さんはご存知ですか？
dialogue.English: Does your fiancé know that you're even considering breaking off the engagement?

dialogue.content: いえ、まだそれが言えていなくて。。。
dialogue.English: No, I haven't been able to tell him that yet...

dialogue.content: なるほど、言うのに勇気入りますよね
dialogue.English: I see. It takes courage to say something like that.

dialogue.content: そこまで悩んでいるってこと、何とか伝えたいですよね
dialogue.English: You want to convey how much you're struggling with this, right?

dialogue.content: はい。。。
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: 他にも気になることってございますか？
dialogue.English: Is there anything else that's on your mind?

dialogue.content: いえ。。。ただ、彼はこれまでとても優しくて思いやりのある人だったので、ここに来て急変したのには何か訳があるのかとか考えてしまって。。。
dialogue.English: No... It's just that he's always been a very kind and considerate person, so I can't help but wonder if there's a reason for this sudden change...

dialogue.content: なるほど、気になりますね・・・何か思い当たることってございますか？
dialogue.English: I see, that is puzzling... Can you think of anything that might have caused it?

dialogue.content: いえ、全く。。。。ただ、仕事のクライアントさんが若い男性だったりする事も多いので、本当は仕事やめて欲しかったりしたのかな。。。と、ふと思いました。
dialogue.English: No, not at all... But, it just occurred to me that many of my clients at work are young men, so maybe he secretly wanted me to quit my job all along...

dialogue.content: なるほど、彼氏さん気になってたんですかね
dialogue.English: I see, perhaps your fiancé was bothered by that.

dialogue.content: 考えすぎですかね。私があまりにも仕事好きって言うから言い辛かったのかもしれないですけど。。。
dialogue.English: Maybe I'm overthinking it. It might have been hard for him to say anything because I always talk about how much I love my job...

dialogue.content: 責めるんじゃなくて、もっと話し合うべきですかね。。。
dialogue.English: Maybe I should try to talk it over more, instead of just blaming him...

dialogue.content: はい、、少しお話をまとめさせて頂いて宜しいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Yes... May I summarize what you've shared so far?

dialogue.content: はい、お願いします。
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: 7年間優しく接してくれた彼氏さんと婚約し、共働きを続けるつもりが、、
dialogue.English: You became engaged to your boyfriend, who has treated you kindly for seven years, and you had planned to continue as a dual-income couple, but...

dialogue.content: 彼氏さんのご両親から同居＆専業主婦をと言われ、とまどっていた。彼氏さんもご両親に言えず、
dialogue.English: But you were taken aback when his parents told you to live with them and become a full-time homemaker. Your fiancé couldn't speak up to his parents,

dialogue.content: もしかしたら彼氏さんも専業主婦を望まれていたのかもしれない、という事に最近気づかれた。
dialogue.English: and you've recently started to wonder if perhaps he also wanted you to be a homemaker all along.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 相談者さまは、大好きな仕事は続けたい、でも彼氏さんとも結婚したい、、
dialogue.English: You want to continue the job you love, but you also want to marry your fiancé...

dialogue.content: はい。。。
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: ですね。たった一度の人生で、一番重要な局面かと思います。
dialogue.English: I agree. This may be one of the most important turning points of your life.

dialogue.content: 共感いただいて有難うございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for your empathy.

dialogue.content: ここまでいろいろお話しいただき有難うございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing so much with me today.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ有難うございます。
dialogue.English: No, thank you.

dialogue.content: 少し感じた事をお伝えさせて頂いてよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: Would it be okay if I shared a few of my thoughts?

dialogue.content: はい、お願いします。
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: はい、、
dialogue.English: Okay...

dialogue.content: 相談者さまは大好きな仕事と、共働きをし、彼氏さんとも幸せな家庭をつくりたい、
dialogue.English: You want to continue with your beloved career, have a dual-income household, and build a happy family with your fiancé.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: たぶん、婚約破棄までは考えたくなく、、
dialogue.English: And you probably don't want to go as far as breaking off the engagement...

dialogue.content: あ、それは大分考えていました。。、
dialogue.English: Oh, I've actually been thinking about that quite a bit...

dialogue.content: ということは、彼氏さんとじっくりお話しされる必要があるように感じます。そこまで不安で、悩んでいることを彼氏さんは知らないようですし
dialogue.English: In that case, it seems you need to have a thorough discussion with your fiancé. It sounds like he doesn't know the extent of your anxiety and how much you're struggling.

dialogue.content: いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What do you think?

dialogue.content: そうですね。もう一度じっくり話合ってみようと思います！
dialogue.English: You're right. I'll try having a more in-depth discussion with him again!

dialogue.content: ご両親のお考えもあるかと重pいますが、まずはご当人のお二人のお考えを
dialogue.English: I'm sure his parents' opinions matter, but first, the two of you need to discuss your own thoughts.

dialogue.content: 話し合われた方が良さそうですね
dialogue.English: It seems best for you to talk it out.

dialogue.content: そうですね、、
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: ぜひ話あわれてみてください！
dialogue.English: Please, do try to talk it over!

dialogue.content: そうですね、有難うございます。自分の気持や不安は投げつけてみたものの、相手の気持ちをちゃんと聞いていなかった事を反省しました。
dialogue.English: You're right, thank you. I realize that while I threw my feelings and anxieties at him, I hadn't truly listened to his feelings.

dialogue.content: はい、、気づきがあって良かったです
dialogue.English: Yes—I'm glad you had that realization.

dialogue.content: 婚約破棄はそれからでも遅く無いので笑自分達の結婚なんだという事をお互い自覚して話し合ってみたいと思います！
dialogue.English: It's not too late to break off the engagement after that, haha. I want us to talk it over, with both of us recognizing that this is our own marriage!

dialogue.content: はい！ ぜひそうしてください！！
dialogue.English: Yes! Please do!!

dialogue.content: 一人だと突っ走ってしまうので、冷静になれました。
dialogue.English: When I'm alone, I tend to rush into things, but this helped me calm down.

dialogue.content: 有難うございました！
dialogue.English: Thank you very much!

dialogue.content: はい、良かったです。
dialogue.English: You're welcome—I'm glad to hear that.

dialogue.content: お二人でお幸せになれることを心から祈っております
dialogue.English: I sincerely hope that the two of you can find happiness together.

dialogue.content: 今日のご相談は、他には大丈夫でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is there anything else you'd like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: はい、十分相談に乗って頂きました。
dialogue.English: No, you've given me more than enough support.

dialogue.content: 有難うございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 良かったです。。有難うございました。
dialogue.English: I'm glad to hear that. Thank you.
